defects.reason: Contraction pass: source 'he is not cunning, not practised' is an emphatic parallel of negations in Razumihin's pronouncement ('I maintain'). 'isn't cunning, not experienced' breaks the parallel and weakens the stress; keep the long form here.

accessibility.reason: Source 'I wanted to blow him up' means scold; 'give him a piece of my mind' keeps that meaning and removes the 'explode' mishearing.

Source says only 'as they called them at school'; the very next sentence ('I'm actually proud of these trousers') resolves the reference. Spelling out the joke adds an explanation the source does not give.

Source 11.53 has Nikolay find the box 'in the corner by the door'; Raskolnikov's 'Behind the door?' (11.54) and 11.73's 'behind the door' are also in the source. The discrepancy is the source's own, and Raskolnikov's echo is a telling reaction; harmonizing it alters Nikolay's testimony.
Source: 'in the flat when Nikolay and Dmitri had just run out of it'. The relative-clause version keeps the meaning and fixes the tangled tense.
Pure grammar fix; content matches source 12.19 ('whose familiarity seemed so much like unaffected good-nature').

accessibility.reason: The need is real, but the proposal moves the thick growth to the cheeks. Source: whiskers 'made an agreeable setting on both sides, growing thickly upon his shining, clean-shaven chin' (i.e. thickening toward/around the chin). Keep the thickening at the chin while removing the contradiction.
